title: The Nullborn/Ravenblade and Saya Conflict
description: Yoshiko intervenes in a fight between Ravenblade and Saya to clarify the truth about the Nullborn and DEW's activities.
quote: and while she also fought saya ,while saya back in that time was held the mission of killing nullborn members including Ravenblade .so in that ravenblade and saya fight nyxia went there to stop the fight.

title: The Opening of The Silence
description: The invisible barrier monitored by the agency opened, allowing a military task force to enter an unknown world.
quote: And one day, The Silence opened. The task force stood ready at its edge. Elite men and women handpicked from decades of service.

title: The Red Moon Under Dusk
description: A battle between Saya and Nyxia Vale against the mutated Project Voren in an abandoned metro station.
quote: The scene: abandoned metro station at night. Neon lights flicker, tunnels echo like heartbeats. Nyxia and Saya are alone — until the lights die.

title: The Resurrection Experiment
description: Zaan and Raisa attempt a forbidden scientific ritual to revive a corpse, resulting in Zaan's death and miraculous return.
quote: Zaan’s body jerked violently. His burnt chest heaved once. Twice. Then— His eyes opened.
sources: Trilogy of zaan, khalid and issabela (1).pdf

title: The Rise of Elizah
description: Following Ethan's death, Elizah emerges as a brutal, solo operator who defies the established authority.
quote: Season 2 opens with Elizah — the embodiment of that pain — rising from his ashes.

title: The Rise of the Sentinels
description: Ethan is recruited by ECAP and forms the Sentinels alongside Zayn and Xinea.
quote: then they gave it the name of sentinels.where basically sentinels is a new org, runs by ecap. later Ethan immdiately calls zayn.his childhood best friend.

title: The Roar of Duskmoor
description: Rowan forces himself up from critical injuries and roars his refusal to surrender to Arthur, igniting Silas's chains.
quote: EPISODE SEGMENT — “THE ROAR OF DUSKMOOR” The Battlefield — Earth’s Ruin

title: The Separation
description: Dragons attempted to infiltrate the human realm by taking human form, but lower dragons were exposed and culled by hunters.
quote: When the Separation happened, dragons saw opportunity: Humans trapped in their own realm. Other races blocked out. Perfect time to sneak in and dominate the weakest species.

title: The Slaughter at the Village
description: The villagers, manipulated by rumors, kill Shina and Grandma Ayesha, driving Zaan into a vengeful rage.
quote: The door shattered. Villagers flooded in. Torches scorched the walls. Shina backed up, terrified, as spears pointed at her womb.
sources: Trilogy of zaan, khalid and issabela (1).pdf

title: The Storm Rebellion
description: Atrocities of DEW were exposed during this event, leading to internal collapse when Samuel turned on them.
quote: Exposure of their atrocities during “The Storm Rebellion.” Internal collapse when Samuel (Ghost-01) turned on them, leaking files to the public.

title: The Throne of Defiance
description: John defeats Khalid and claims the throne as a symbol of defiance.
quote: The throne was born in cruelty. Khalid carved it as a symbol of fear, a monument to his dominance. Many bent the knee before it — none sat upon it by right. Until John.

title: The Throne of Ego
description: Ariyan claims the throne as a symbol of his superiority and pride.
quote: Centuries later, Ariyan — once Robin’s disciple, now hardened by neglect and twisted by Sammam’s gray creed — stumbled upon the throne.

title: The Throne of Guardianship
description: Liam and his bloodline protect the throne as a monument of loyalty to John.
quote: Through Liam’s bloodline, generation after generation stood watch over the chair. Not to rule from it, but to honor the one who had.

title: The Throne of Silence
description: Robin destroys the throne, ending its legacy.
quote: And so, with blood and wind, Robin shattered it into dust. No words. No rage. No acknowledgment. The throne that had stood for centuries was gone in a blink.

title: Tie the Knife
description: Samuel Sterling arrives at a ruined army camp to assist Arzuna in defeating augmented creations and a demonic-blood experiment.
quote: EPISODE SEGMENT — “Tie the Knife” (Season 4 | Arzuna × Samuel — Part 2)

title: Victor's Death
description: Victor passed away after confessing his responsibility for the project's failure to the world.
quote: in the healing process of grace,he stood and all of a sudden ran to see him but sadly,he was dead.

title: War of the Nine Clans Against Jessy
description: The Nine Clans fought Jessy during her prime in a war lasting seven days and nights, eventually sealing her soul.
quote: The 9 Superior Clans fought Jessy during her prime, in a war that raged for seven days and nights. Their combined might could not kill her, but they succeeded in sealing her soul.
